### Discover our library locations and services available for you at each campus of RMIT Vietnam.

## Library services

### Ask A Librarian Chat Service

Get help from Librarians via online chat service.

### Referencing tools

Ace your citations with our referencing tools and guides.

### Subject guides

Find reputation databases and sources to use in your studies.

### Book assignment consultation

Book a face-to-face or online consultation with our Liaison Librarians.

### Learning resources

Search for books, articles, databases and more.

### Learning services

Get help with tutorials and workshops in searching skills and referencing

Visit the Library website

## Contact details

### Saigon South campus

The Beanland Library & Learning Commons 1.3.30, Academic Building 1

Phone: 028 3776 1319

Email: library@rmit.edu.vn

### Hanoi campus

Hanoi Library 1.2.006, Handi Resco Building

Phone: 024 3724 5920

Email: hanoi.library@rmit.edu.vn

## Library opening hours

### During semester

Monday to Friday: 8am - 9pm

Saturday and Sunday: 8am - 5pm

### Semester break

Monday to Friday: 8am - 5pm, closed on weekends
